description:
One day, Min-hyuk suddenly sees the narrator and realizes that he is Sub-Gong from a BL comic. 
The narrator warns Minhyuk that if he doesn't connect the main couple, they won't need him and he will disappear. 
Min-hyuk is a sub-gong who likes Demo, but in order not to disappear, he tries to connect the main couple, Demo and Eun-sung. 
However, when both Demo and Eun-sung show interest in Min-hyuk, the three of them unintentionally start dating...

[Original Webtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/2plus1)
